question: RustDesk command-line flags used by the engine bridge (--connect, --password, --get-id, --option) are from RustDesk's public behaviour, not from the Parsec evidence; they must be checked against the installed RustDesk version.
probes: Run rustdesk.exe --get-id on a machine with RustDesk installed
resolution: RustDesk is not installed on this computer, so the flags could not be tried. The app shows clear errors if a flag is refused, and lets the person type the RustDesk ID by hand.
